title: The Word of Wisdom: The Principle and the Promises
author: Boyd K. Packer
calling_raw: Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
notes_text: 1.  The context for verse 18 is verse 19: “For, behold, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the air [are] ordained for the use of man for food.” Section 49 was specifically directed to members of the United Society of Believers in Christ’s Second Appearing (the Shakers) to correct some of their erroneous doctrines. One of their beliefs was not to eat flesh-meat or fish.
